claims.claim: SparrowDesk offers an AI agent (Zoona) that reads support tickets and auto-resolves them across email, chat, and other channels, with human handoff when needed.

excerpts.excerpt: Zoona reads every ticket, works out what the customer needs, and answers on its own - day or night. Your team steps in only when a human's needed.

claims.claim: Zoona is trained by pointing it at existing resources like website, help center, Notion, docs, and past conversations, without manual writing.

excerpts.excerpt: Zoona learns from what you already have - your website, help center, Notion, docs, even past conversations. Point it at your sources and it starts answering. You don't write a thing.

claims.claim: The product supports multiple channels (email, live chat, WhatsApp, Slack) and multiple languages.

excerpts.excerpt: Email, live chat, WhatsApp, Slack - Zoona works across all of them. It responds in the language your customer writes in, so language is never a barrier to great support.

claims.claim: SparrowDesk includes a built-in CSAT feature that sends surveys after ticket resolution and reports on satisfaction trends.

excerpts.excerpt: Send CSAT surveys automatically after a support interaction is completed. Feedback is collected when it makes sense, without manual effort.

claims.claim: SparrowDesk offers tiered pricing plans (Free, Starter, Professional, Enterprise) starting from $16 per agent, with a 14-day free trial.

excerpts.excerpt: Helpdesk plans from $16 per agent. Email, chat, shared inbox, and help center in one place. Try any plan free for 14 days, no credit card required.

claims.claim: The company states it is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant, and that customer data is not used to train AI models.

excerpts.excerpt: SparrowDesk is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Your data is never used to train AI models.

claims.caveat: This figure appears only on the company's own pages, which are the same voice; no independent source confirms it.
claims.claim: The company claims to be 'trusted by 1,000+ support teams,' a figure repeated on multiple company pages but not independently verified.

claims.caveat: This is a single testimonial quote on the company's own site, not independently verified data.
claims.claim: A customer testimonial states Zoona handles more than 67% of conversations for one company (UprootSecurity), though this is an unverified single-customer quote.

excerpts.excerpt: with Zoona handling more than 67% of conversations, our small team can keep up as customer support grows.

claims.claim: The company's Show HN launch received minimal community engagement (1 point, 0 comments).

excerpts.excerpt: The thread has 1 points on Hacker News. The thread has 0 comments on Hacker News.
